references.label: Movie Screen scoop
references.description: The upper-middle scoop starts Dynamite Features, M-Ball, LAH 6-Ball, and World Premiere when lit.

references.label: Wildcard scoop
references.description: The right-side scoop selects a missing LAST, ACTION, or HERO word and can double some active modes.

references.label: Left captive ball
references.description: The lower-left captive ball advances M-Ball and resets one active mode timer once.

references.label: Right captive ball
references.description: The upper-right captive ball advances M-Ball and is used during Go to the Movies.

references.label: C-R-A-N-E drop bank
references.description: The left-side bank supplies the moving skill shot and qualifies the Crane lock.

references.label: Crane shot and lock
references.description: The shot just right of the ramp collects Crane awards and locks up to two balls for M-Ball.

references.label: Roof ramp
references.description: The upper-left ramp relights the Movie scoop and collects M-Ball jackpots.

references.label: Lt. Dekker spinner
references.description: The spinner beside the Movie scoop feeds the pop bumpers and supplies LAH switch waves.
